<issue>
NamedExpr target and value attributes swapped

#### Description

When creating a NamedExpr (walrus operator `:=`) node, the target and value attributes are incorrectly assigned. The target should contain the variable being assigned to, but it contains the value instead, and vice versa.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
import astroid

code = """
if (a := 1):
    pass
"""

module = astroid.parse(code)
named_expr = module.body[0].test

print(f"Target: {named_expr.target}")  # Should be AssignName 'a'
print(f"Value: {named_expr.value}")    # Should be Const 1
print(f"Target name: {named_expr.target.name}")  # Should be 'a'
print(f"Value value: {named_expr.value.value}")  # Should be 1
```

Expected output:
```
Target: <AssignName.a l.2 at 0x...>
Value: <Const.int l.2 at 0x...>
Target name: a
Value value: 1
```

Actual output:
```
Target: <Const.int l.2 at 0x...>
Value: <AssignName.a l.2 at 0x...>
Target name: AttributeError: 'Const' object has no attribute 'name'
Value value: AttributeError: 'AssignName' object has no attribute 'value'
```

This affects any code that relies on the correct assignment of target and value in walrus operator expressions.
</issue>
